mentions.name: Ovio
mentions.description: This app provides record-keeping for Australian freelancers, sole traders, and small businesses. Users send receipts by email or WhatsApp and import bank transactions from CSV; Ovio extracts the receipt details and automatically reconciles transactions. It offers a BAS/GST-style summary and exports organised records for an accountant.
mentions.problem: Manual record-keeping for freelancers and small businesses — organising receipts, bank transactions, and tax records for BAS/GST and accountants; the author says it solves their exact problem.
mentions.audience: Australian freelancers, sole traders, and small businesses
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Ovio (https://ovio.au), a record-keeping app for Australian freelancers/sole traders/small businesses.
